notes.title: DONT MOVE - RELEASED TODAY
notes.notes: [p]Very pleased to announce that the beta testing period is over and DONT MOVE has reached full release status![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the community and testers for giving me valuable feedback and making some suggestions for additional scares - which have been added to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Submissions are open on the Discord and Steam Community thread for new levels to add. Will also be releasing some DLC down the line.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks and 'DONT MOVE'[/p][p][/p][p]The Dev[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]ABOUT THE GAME[/p][p][/p][p]DON'T MOVE is an immersive VR game where your ability to HOLD YOUR NERVE and stay PERFECTLY STILL, no matter what comes at you is key to succeeding.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Perfect for Friends and Families - Using the 'GALLERY' mode - and unlocked sequences can be replayed at any time.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Challenge each other to 'hold your nerve' for as long as possible.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]A statement from the FLINCH-INC Dummy Testing Facility - [/p][p align="start"][i]Here in the test facility we use every testing apparatus available, no matter how ludicrous. To test the strength and resolve of all our dummies. We pride ourselves on creating dummies with near zero 'flinch' mechanics. As our founder famously stated time and time again. 'You won't find a more willing dummy - than a 'Flinch-Inc' dummy[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564045/560c18d929e465f8ae8941c4beee9e37c09d5629.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DONT MOVE - Demo Released
notes.notes:
The demo has just been made live in time for Steam Next-Fest where DONT MOVE is featured.

Finally - I have completed the demo and clicked 'release' - After a 6 month solo-development I am so happy to have been able to get my game on Steam.

The demo is a showcase of around half of the test sequences and without the full ending.
You will need to purchase the full game on release (late June) to get the full experience.
